description.value:
Dwarfen Resilience. The creature has advantage on saving throws against poison and disease, and resistance to poison damage. Once per turn when it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw, it may reduce the next bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage it takes before the start of its next turn by 2.

This discipline is learned in mud, ash, and shouted command. It changes how the warrior occupies the field: where allies stand firmer, enemies hesitate, and a single heartbeat of motion becomes the difference between slaughter and survival.

“A grudge is a stone. Carry it long enough and it becomes a mountain.”
— a Dwarf thane

source.book: Warhammer: The Old World x D&D 5e
